name: cult-ui-dock
blurb: Floating dock with magnifying zoom on hover, spring-based animations.
description: Dock component with animated zoom magnification on hover. Children are DockCard items. Mouse proximity triggers scaling via spring physics.
use_when: Floating toolbars or action menus where hover magnification adds polish.
avoid_when: Touch-only interfaces; magnification requires pointer tracking.
a11y: Dock is a landmark (aria-label). Dock items are keyboard-focusable. Animations respect prefers-reduced-motion where possible.
